note: CODE DERIVATION: positional. data/salleh_2023_aim_iam_fim.py enumerates the 12 item columns of PLOS ONE S1 Dataset (10.1371/journal.pone.0294238.s001; s002 is byte-identical, md5 aa88d170e2a8fc00d7ba7737d6d280c4) into item_01..item_12; re-derived in verify_salleh_2023_aim_iam_fim.R (live item_NN == source column NN for 170/170 respondents on all 12; largest off-diagonal agreement 151/170). WORDS: header row 1 of s001 is the Malay item text; it ties column to text (mapping_basis=data_labels), 12/12 headers are prefixes of the paper's Table 2 Malay wording in the same order. Seven headers are truncated by one final character (item_02 'say ' -> 'saya', item_03 'KOSPE', item_04 'bai', item_06 and item_10 'masyaraka', item_11 'sukarelawa'); the missing character was restored from Table 2, which prints the complete Malay string for all 12 (the processing script's header comment made the same restorations). Nothing else altered. ADMINISTERED FORM: this file is the Phase 2 KOSPEN pilot (n=170, online Google Form, EFA sample). The only published questionnaire, S1 File (s003.pdf, sha256 bcc31b0fbcee42d7cda954fcc2ae7a86cf3af7b9859e29045f899fc5d9bc5549), is the Phase 3 MIICA form and names MIICA alone (e.g. 'Program MIICA memenuhi persetujuan saya'; item 8 'progam imunisasi sedia ada'). item_text ships the data file's own combined 'Program MIICA/ KOSPEN' label (item 8 'program imunisasi/ kesihatan sedia ada'), which is programme-neutral; the KOSPEN form itself is not published, so the literal programme name respondents read is unconfirmed. instructions left blank for the same reason: S1 File's Malay instructions name the measles programme ('Program Intervensi Imunisasi Campak ... (MIICA)') and do not describe this KOSPEN sample. OPTIONS: Malay anchors 'Sangat tidak setuju','Tidak setuju','Neutral','Setuju','Sangat setuju' from S1 File's Malay form (column order left to right); resp 1..5 per the paper's Methods ('1, completely disagree; 2, disagree; 3, neither agree nor disagree; 4, agree; and 5, completely agree'); processing script stores the source integers unchanged. Anchors are taken from the MIICA form and assumed shared by the KOSPEN form. TRANSLATION: item_text_translated = the paper's own English in Table 2 verbatim (e.g. item_02 'MIICA/ KOSPEN programme is appealing', which drops Weiner's 'to me'); option_text_translated = S1 File English version anchors. Both study_supplied. SCALE SCOPE: all 12 pre-reduction items; the paper's final validated Malay scale keeps 7 (items 1,3,6,8,9,10,11). RIGHTS: instrument originator Weiner et al. 2017 Implement Sci 12:108 (CC BY 4.0, PMC5576104). Its Additional File 3 ('Final version of the AIM, IAM and FIM', 13012_2017_635_MOESM3_ESM.docx, sha256 adaa0eb31d6a1dc9509362becfb53e29a7ef518abd43ee4f706f8e93b9fd6e29, via Europe PMC supplementaryFiles 2026-09-10) states 'There is no cost to use these measures.' and 'The IAM items could be modified to specify a referent organization, situation, or population'. No fee, permission, NC, ND or no-redistribution term located from the originator; ships on silence plus that no-cost statement. Salleh et al. report 'A request for translation purposes was asked from the owner of the original questionnaire, and permission for the purposes was granted' -- a statement by the study, not a term quoted from the holder. No instrument_rights_register.csv row exists for AIM/IAM/FIM and none was written (rounds may not write ship rows): SHIP-SHAPED, escalated for a human register decision. DATA CAVEAT (paper, not table): paper Table 4 polychorics match live polychorics to <=0.008 in 16/21 cells, but 1-6, 6-9, 6-10, 9-10 and 10-11 are published 0.06-0.15 higher (e.g. 6-9 published .944, live .820) and the text's r(item2,item3)=.973 vs live .88; no single-swap reassignment explains them.
public_note: Item wording is the data file's combined 'Program MIICA/ KOSPEN' label; these 170 respondents are the study's KOSPEN pilot, and the only published form (for MIICA) names one programme, so the programme name respondents actually read is not confirmed
